brief: Members: Aldar has made its first Sharjah investment, an AED1.1bn forward purchase of more than 1,100 Aljada homes from Arada for delivery in Q4 2029, and Arada's release names a Madar Mall among Aljada's continuing developments (15 Oct).

2027 Directory: the first Friday verification checked 15 listings against owners' own disclosures and found 9 changes. Aventura Mall in Kuwait is now due at the end of October, and the 1.8m sqm printed for The Avenues Riyadh is built-up area (GLA about 361,202 sqm, opening March 2027).

Destinations: flooding closed Vadistanbul's car parks in Istanbul (15 Oct), N City in Diyarbakır is being repositioned as the city's first outlet mall, and Oman will open duty-free markets at three land border crossings.

AI and CX: a second outlet confirms Majid Al Futtaim's figure that AI agents play a role in 9% of its customer transactions, Etisalat UAE signed a multi-year deal to govern an agentic AI workforce, and Qatar's Ministry of Municipality reported 89.1% call-centre satisfaction.
Library: ten documents that fill gaps for Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman, Egypt and Türkiye, plus Microsoft's Q2 2026 AI diffusion report (UAE first at 73.3%).
weekly_brief: First week of the combined MECSR and MECSC edition: 62 findings and 32 library documents across the editions of 13 to 16 October, including a catch-up of 26 September to 13 October.

Dubai led the pipeline news: Dubai Retail's Skylight Mall (1.3m sq ft GLA, 2027) and 38 new outlets at Ibn Battuta Mall, Majid Al Futtaim's The Hangout at Mall of the Emirates, the former Lamcy Plaza returning as The Plaza in H1 2027, and a 'Dubai Mall Plaza and Hotel' teaser from Emaar's founder.

Members made big moves: Al Othaim launched Al Othaim Developments with a SAR16bn+ plan, and Aldar followed its AED15bn partnership with Arada by buying AED1.1bn of Aljada homes, its first Sharjah investment, while planning a fourth Dubai project with Dubai Holding.

Agentic AI moved from pilots to rules: every UAE federal AI agent must connect to a 'control tower', the UAE and the World Economic Forum launched a $1 million Agentic AI Award, and Majid Al Futtaim says AI agents already play a role in 9% of its customer transactions.
On the shop floor, Max Fashion brought AI virtual try-on to City Center Doha, Lulu put Odigo robots in UAE stores as a retail media channel, and OpenAI added try-on to ChatGPT shopping.

Türkiye stayed busy: Florentia Village Istanbul and Merkez Ankara AVM are trading, N City in Diyarbakır is being repositioned as an outlet mall, and flooding closed Vadistanbul's car parks on 15 October.

2027 Directory: the first Friday check of 15 listings against owners' own disclosures found 9 changes, including Aventura Mall now due at the end of October, The Avenues Riyadh at about 361,202 sqm GLA for March 2027, and Westfield Dammam at over 58,000 sqm.

Next: Primark at Doha Festival City (29 Oct), Aventura Mall (end Oct), Q3 results from late October, the UAE services announcement in November, Saudi flight disruption after the Riyadh airport closure, and GITEX (7 to 11 Dec) against RCM Jeddah (7 to 8 Dec).

findings.title: Vadistanbul closes its car parks temporarily after flooding in Istanbul
findings.summary: Mall Report reported on 15 October 2026 that the flood that hit Istanbul also affected Vadistanbul, after a photo of the mall's flooded car park circulated on social media. The management said on Instagram that the car parks were temporarily closed and asked visitors to come by public transport. No reopening date, store closures or damage figures were reported.
findings.why: Weather disruption at a major Istanbul centre is a live case for MECSR and MECSC on shopper communication and business continuity.

findings.company: Global Mall Management (mall manager; owner not named)
findings.title: N City in Diyarbakır is being renovated and repositioned as the city's first outlet mall
findings.summary: Ahmet Duran, founding general manager of Global Mall Management, told Mall Report on 13 October 2026 that N City, which opened in 2007 as Diyarbakır's first shopping centre, is being renovated and repositioned as the city's first outlet mall, N City Outlet. The outlet offer will be supported by food and beverage, entertainment and social spaces, including children's play areas, a cinema and concept stores, and the restaurant chain Köfteci Yusuf will open its first unit in the region there. The target catchment includes Mardin, Batman, Bingöl, Muş and Şanlıurfa; no timing, GLA or store count was given.
findings.why: An early-generation mall switching to an outlet format to win a regional catchment is a repositioning model for older centres in MECSR markets, and the centre is not yet in the Directory.

findings.city: Al Wajajah, Khatmat Malaha and Rub Al Khali crossings
findings.entity: Duty-free markets at three land border crossings
findings.company: Royal Oman Police (Inspector General of Police and Customs)
findings.title: Oman to set up duty-free markets at three land border crossings with the UAE and Saudi Arabia
findings.summary: Lt Gen Hassan bin Mohsin Al Shuraiqi, Inspector General of Police and Customs, issued Decision No 145/2026 establishing duty-free markets at the Al Wajajah and Khatmat Malaha crossings on the UAE border and the Rub Al Khali crossing on the Saudi border, Muscat Daily reported on 13 October 2026. Goods will be sold exempt from customs duties and taxes, subject to applicable regulations, to boost activity at the land ports, support tourism and logistics and give travellers more shopping options. No start date, operator, size or investment was given.
findings.why: Duty free at road borders is a new travel-retail format in the GCC that could capture spend from UAE and Saudi visitors and open tenders for retail operators.

directory.angle: Oman is setting up duty-free markets at its land borders with the UAE and Saudi Arabia, turning road crossings into shopping stops for GCC visitors.

directory.caution: No start date, operator, size or goods list yet; confirm with Royal Oman Police or ONA before print.

findings.title: Aventura Mall: Mabanee's own figures put the opening at the end of October 2026 and GLA at 108,297 sqm
findings.summary: Mabanee told analysts on 29 July 2026 that Aventura Mall, due to open in August, had been postponed to the end of October, with leasing above 70%. A Mabanee disclosure on Boursa Kuwait dated 10 June 2026 gives the mall 108,297 sqm of gross leasable area, and Zawya, citing Mabanee's Q1 2026 results, put construction at 96 percent with 377 retail units in Jaber Al-Ahmad City. No primary source had reported the mall open by 15 October.
findings.why: The 2027 book prints 'Opened 2026 Q3' and GLA 108,200 sqm; Mabanee's own figures change both, and the opening is due within weeks.

findings.title: Mall of Al Ain: the owner's filing does not fit the printed 2021 opening year

Construction is scheduled to begin in Q4 2026 and is phased so the mall stays open; the 'nearly three times' growth in the filing refers to the ice rink, not the whole mall. findings.why: The listing's opening year and owner line need correcting before print, and the redevelopment changes the centre's status for 2027.

findings.company: Aldar Properties (buyer); Arada (seller and master developer)
findings.title: Aldar makes its first Sharjah investment: an AED1.1bn forward purchase of Aljada homes from Arada
findings.summary: Aldar has agreed an AED1.1 billion forward purchase of three residential blocks, comprising more than 1,100 units across nine buildings, in Arada's Aljada master community in Sharjah, for delivery by Arada in Q4 2029. It is Aldar's first real estate investment in the emirate, lifts its develop-to-hold pipeline to AED21 billion and builds on the AED15 billion development partnership the two companies announced in late September. Arada's release, dated 15 October 2026, says Aljada spans 2.2 million sqm with more than 300,000 sq ft of occupied retail space, and names Madar Mall among its continuing developments.
findings.why: A member landlord is entering Sharjah through Arada's flagship community, where a mall is in the pipeline for the Directory to track.

findings.title: Majid Al Futtaim figures confirmed: AI agents play a role in 9% of customer transactions
findings.summary: A second outlet now carries the figures that Majid Al Futtaim chief executive Ahmed Galal Ismail gave at the Sharjah Investment Forum on 14 October 2026, which the 15 October edition held back. Sharjah24 reports that AI agents play a role in 9% of the group's customer transactions, by recommending products, influencing choices or directing purchases, and that 25% of its retail business is conducted online; Gulf News reported the same figures, giving the online share as a quarter of the business. The group has issued no release of its own.
findings.why: A member's own measure of how far AI agents already influence purchases is a hard benchmark for MECSC customer-experience and agentic-commerce content.

findings.entity: Ministry of Municipality customer service and Unified Call Center
findings.title: Qatar's Ministry of Municipality reports 89.1% call-centre satisfaction and 891,218 digital transactions
findings.summary: From 1 January to 31 August 2026, Qatar's Ministry of Municipality completed 891,218 transactions through digital channels, including 461,459 on its website and 191,040 in the Oun app. Its Customer Service Department and Unified Call Center provided 238,719 services and received 188,280 calls, with satisfaction of 89.1% for the call centre and 83.82% for the customer service offices. The Peninsula (11 October) and Al Raya (10 October) report identical figures.
findings.why: Published satisfaction scores for a Gulf ministry's call centre and service offices give MECSC a public-sector benchmark and a possible Qatar case study.

findings.title: Etisalat UAE signs a multi-year DataRobot deal to build and govern an agentic AI workforce
findings.summary: Etisalat UAE has extended its partnership with DataRobot through a multi-year agreement to build, operate and govern an agentic AI workforce across its business units, using the DataRobot Agent Workforce Platform within its sovereign AI ecosystem. Predictive, generative and agentic AI will run under one governance framework, with sensitive data and AI workloads kept on Etisalat UAE's own infrastructure. The companies have worked together since 2022 on customer value management, including churn prevention, upsell and cross-sell targeting and credit risk; no value was disclosed.
findings.why: A major Gulf consumer brand is putting AI agents into customer-facing work under central governance, the same model the UAE now requires of federal AI agents.

findings.title: Zain Kuwait backs ETLAQ's 'Agentic AI Experience' to help Kuwaiti firms deploy AI agents
findings.summary: Zain Kuwait has announced a strategic partnership with ETLAQ, which created and runs The Agentic AI Experience, a programme that helps business owners and executives design and deploy teams of AI agents with defined responsibilities, permissions and human approval points. Its masterclass runs at GUST from 2 November to 2 December 2026, alongside mentoring, talks and a showcase. Kuwait's ICT regulator CITRA is the digital trust partner, and its chairman said permissions and responsibility for agents' actions must be clearly defined.
findings.why: Kuwait's telecom leader and its ICT regulator are setting expectations for how businesses run AI agents, which makes them useful partners and speakers for MECSR's Kuwait members and AI content.

findings.title: OpenAI adds virtual try-on and saved favourites to ChatGPT shopping
findings.summary: OpenAI has added a 'Try On' button to supported clothing and accessory listings in ChatGPT shopping: users take or upload a selfie and ChatGPT Images generates a picture of them wearing the item, while a Favorites feature saves products to the ChatGPT Library. TechRepublic reported the launch on 2 October 2026 for mobile and web, and Gulf News said the global rollout began on 1 October. The preview cannot confirm fit or size, and reference photos are kept for future try-ons and can be removed in settings.
findings.why: Try-on now sits inside a general-purpose assistant that shoppers use before they reach a mall or a brand's own app, the same feature Gulf fashion retailers are adding in store.
